title: Community food drives
description: Food drives would bring together non-perishable groceries and everyday essentials for households experiencing difficult circumstances.
actions: Ask which non-perishable items are most useful.
Help sort, pack or distribute supplies.
Coordinate a collection with a school, church or community group.
alt: Groceries arranged for a community food collection

title: Clothing support
description: A clothing collection would help redirect clean, wearable clothing to people who could use it, while encouraging thoughtful reuse.
actions: Set aside clean clothing in good condition.
Help sort donations by type and size.
Support a safe, organised collection day.
alt: Items prepared for a donation and community support activity

title: Community outreach
description: Outreach activities would create opportunities for volunteers and local groups to listen, connect and coordinate practical support.
actions: Volunteer time or a relevant skill.
Help plan an inclusive, respectful activity.
alt: Volunteers working together on a community initiative
